description: The grants a principal needs on one App object: the notebook (implement_scope_grant_statements) and the backend (scopeGrantStatements) must both produce these exact statements, in this order.

statements: GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG `main` TO `bob@example.com`
GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA `main`.`s` TO `bob@example.com`
GRANT READ METADATA ON TABLE `main`.`s`.`orders_scope` TO `bob@example.com`
GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG `main` TO `app-sp-2`
GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA `main`.`s` TO `app-sp-2`
GRANT READ METADATA ON TABLE `main`.`s`.`orders_scope` TO `app-sp-2`
GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG `prod` TO `grp-analysts`
GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA `prod`.`sales_core` TO `grp-analysts`
GRANT READ METADATA ON TABLE `prod`.`sales_core`.`v_orders` TO `grp-analysts`
